name: Dump-in forecheck
caption: Your team just dumped the puck in. Their D is picking it up behind the net on the {side} side and their forwards are curling back to help. Nobody on your line has a forecheck role yet.

options.text: Go hard at their D behind the net. I am F1.
options.feedback: Your center is already there. Two forwards on the carrier leaves nobody on the outlet, and the far wing is now both F2 and F3.

options.text: Read who is first. My center is, so I take F2: close on the strong-side wall where the D wants to pass.
options.feedback: Right. F2 reads where F1 forces the puck and takes the outlet. Here that is the wall on your side, so get there before the pass does.

options.text: Stay high at the top of the circle as F3 so we are not caught.
options.feedback: Safe but passive. F3 is the job of the forward furthest away, and that is your left wing. Second-closest means F2, and F2 has to move.

options.text: Drive to the net front for a rebound.
options.feedback: Nobody on your team has the puck. A body at the net front before possession is a body doing nothing while their D breaks out.

options.text: Go hard at their D behind the net. I am F1.
options.feedback: Yes. You are closest, so you are F1 by arrival. Angle him toward the boards, take away his time, and let your center take F2.

options.text: Read who is first. My center is, so I take F2: close on the strong-side wall where the D wants to pass.
options.feedback: Reasonable thinking, but look again: you are the closest one, not your center. Hesitating gives their D a free first pass.

options.text: Stay high at the top of the circle as F3 so we are not caught.
options.feedback: Safe but passive. F3 is the job of the forward furthest away, and that is your left wing. Second-closest means F2, and F2 has to move.

options.text: Drive to the net front for a rebound.
options.feedback: Nobody on your team has the puck. A body at the net front before possession is a body doing nothing while their D breaks out.

questions.prompt: Tap your three forwards in the order they take F1, F2 and F3.

fb.right: Right. Arrival order, nothing else: closest is F1 on the carrier, next is F2 on the outlet, furthest stays high as F3.
fb.f1: You found F1, which is the hard one. F2 is whoever is next closest, not whoever is on the puck side.
fb.wrong: Start from the puck. Who gets to the carrier first? That player is F1 regardless of position. Then count outward.
